AM5.upgrade_horizon: Support extended through 2029; promise upgrades only as far as Zen 6 (Olympic Ridge, expected 2027). Zen 7 socket is disputed.

LGA1700.memory_note: Each board is either DDR4 or DDR5, never both.

LGA1851.upgrade_horizon: No CPU upgrade path: the next socket is LGA1954 (Nova Lake, 900-series), expected Q1 2027.

B850.gpu_slot_note: 5.0 optional per board: read the board record

Z790.lane_note: A Gen5 M.2 can take 4 lanes and drop the GPU to x8 (board-specific).

W880.note: Workstation chipset; ECC route on LGA1851.

bios_minimums.requirement: a BIOS update on existing 800-series boards

platforms.igpu_rules_note: Ordered; the first rule whose families contain cpu.family and whose sku_regex (if any) matches the SKU token of cpu.model (e.g. 7500F, 14600KF, 265KF) decides. The DB cpu.igpu field wins; a contradiction is IGPU_DATA_CONFLICT. Classes: display-office = display and office work, not gaming; light-gaming = 780M/760M class [I].

igpu_class_text.light-gaming: light gaming only (780M/760M class); not a substitute for a gaming GPU

platforms.cpu_families_note: Canonical cpu.family slugs. Lookup normalises the DB value (lowercase, spaces/underscores/hyphens unified, vendor words and 'series' dropped, '14th gen' -> core-14); a value that does not resolve to a slug is 'cannot check', never guessed. An absent family is derived from cpu.model with cpu_family_from_model.

power.catalog_note: Default sizes only. Pass the sizes the caller actually stocks in units that pass the quality rules (--psu-catalog or build.psu_catalog_w). An empty catalog is rejected.
power.policy: No overkill. recommended = smallest stocked, quality-qualified size >= max(DC/0.80, gpu.min_system_psu_w). HARD only below DC/0.90 or below the card maker's minimum system PSU. WARN below DC/0.80. DC/0.70 is an optional quiet target (INFO).

power_config_types.native_16pin: one native 12V-2x6/16-pin PSU cable rated at least min_cable_w
power_config_types.adapter_8pin: the card maker's included adapter fed by at least min_cables independent dedicated PCIe 8-pin cables
power_config_types.direct_8pin: at least min_cables independent PCIe 8-pin cables to the card's own 8-pin sockets

power.known_standards_note: PSU and connector standards newer than these (e.g. an ATX 3.2 or a new GPU connector) are NOT_IN_RULES_DATA until researched.

cooling.class_note: null = no research ceiling (the top class). A class not listed (e.g. aio_240) was not covered by the research and is reported as cannot-check.

advice.over_100: Use a good dual tower (up to ~160 W).
advice.over_160: Use a 360 AIO or a top dual tower (230 W+ class).

vram_model_fit.fits: 32B at Q8, or 70B at ~Q2-Q3 or with offload

workstation.note: ECC: AM5 support is board-dependent; W880 on LGA1851.

linux-gaming.note: AMD GPU by default; NVIDIA with caveats; check buyer.games against the anti-cheat snapshot.

steamos-living-room.note: AMD GPU (Intel community tier, never NVIDIA); controller-first; no dual boot. Steam Machine reference: Zen 4 6-core, RDNA3 28 CU 8 GB, 16 GB DDR5 [V].

modes.check: Default. Missing inputs on HARD/WARN rules are WARN 'cannot check'. Exit 0/2/3.
modes.final: --final. Unknown fields are rejected (exit 3). A HARD rule that could not run makes the result incomplete (exit 3) unless a HARD finding already failed (exit 2). A published compatibility claim may disclose genuine WARNs, never 'cannot check' findings.
modes.publish-gate: --publish-gate on an our-pick.v1 page: runs final mode on the embedded build plus the publish_rules. Exit 0 publishable, 2 blocked, 3 bad input.

publish.max_price_age_note: Default [I]; the caller sets --max-price-age-days to its repricing cycle.

os.note: OS rules run only when build.os is steamos or linux; an absent os means Windows and nothing changes. Research base: docs/research/2026-09-27-pc-builder-os-research.md

steamos.gpu_policy_note: Valve allows SteamOS on DIY desktops with AMD or Intel graphics (Arc B-series included); NVIDIA support is in development with NVIDIA and not expected in 2026. Dual-boot is not recommended; HDMI-CEC is unsupported.
steamos.branding_note: Preinstalling the free image is fine. Without a Valve licence, do not use 'Powered by SteamOS' or 'Steam Machine'; take legal advice before using any Valve mark.

amd.note: RADV/Mesa, in-tree (no Secure Boot signing step); the only vendor fully supported on SteamOS. Mesa 26.2 released 5 Aug 2026.
amd.label: I

intel.note: Xe driver: B580 from kernel 6.12; Xe3 (Panther Lake) stable from 6.17.
intel.label: I

nvidia.note: 595.58.03 recommended stable (modeset on by default); 610 feature branch targets the DX12 deficit; 580 is the last driver for Maxwell, Pascal and Volta; open kernel modules default from Turing; NVK not shipped for gaming. Fine on Bazzite, CachyOS and Pop!_OS; not on SteamOS; DX12 penalty; MOK signing under Secure Boot.
nvidia.label: I

kernel_minimums.text: RDNA4 needs kernel 6.12+ (6.13+ recommended) and Mesa 25.0+
Xe3 (Panther Lake) graphics are stable from kernel 6.17

unsupported.MT7927: MediaTek MT7927 (Filogic 380) has no working Linux Bluetooth and only partial Wi-Fi (patches not merged as of 19 Mar 2026); fit an Intel AX2xx/BE2xx card

regression.RTL8922AE: Realtek RTL8922AE (rtw89) regressed on kernels 6.18+ with no fix yet

fedora-44.eol_note: estimate: about 13 months per release; Fedora 45 due 20 Oct 2026

fedora-45.eol_note: estimate: about 13 months from the 20 Oct 2026 release

disclosures.text: Disclose in writing before sale: the anti-cheat Denied/Broken titles, no PC Game Pass/Xbox/EA app without workarounds, no Microsoft Office desktop apps, Windows-only RGB software, the support scope, and a return path if a must-have game will not run (Consumer Rights Act 'as described').
